rundown: Knicks beat Go-Go 125-104 at Westchester County Center in White Plains, NY. Knicks led 72-59 at the half and never looked back. The 4th quarter decided it: Knicks won it 36-19.
Leading the way — Go-Go: Jazian Gortman 27 pts, 5 ast; Felix Okpara 9 reb. Knicks: Nick Jourdain 27 pts, 13 reb; Jaden Akins 14 ast.
Where Knicks won it: they shot 53% to 50%, shot 43% from three to 38% and won the boards 47-35.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 27, 12:57 PM ET. It had Go-Go 30% and Knicks 70%, projecting Go-Go 96.5 – Knicks 102.8 (199.3 total, Knicks by 6.3).

Final: Go-Go 104 – Knicks 125. Right winner: it had Knicks at 70%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Go-Go came in with a 3% above average attack and a 6% leakier than average defense (1-6, 103.9 scored and 116.4 allowed a game over 7 games), worth about 13 and 13 games of evidence. Projected to score 96.5, they scored 104 (+7.5 points, 8% over); projected to allow 102.8, they allowed 125 (+22.2 points, 22% over).

Knicks came in with a 6% above average attack and a 8% leakier than average defense (2-4, 103.8 scored and 110.8 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 11 and 11 games of evidence. Projected to score 102.8, they scored 125 (+22.2 points, 22% over); projected to allow 96.5, they allowed 104 (+7.5 points, 8% over).

The bigger miss was Knicks' scoring (+22.2 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 229 against 199.3 projected (+29.7), about the 97th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Knicks by 21 against Knicks by 6.3 projected, about the 89th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.171 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +13.5 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 117 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.020 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Go-Go attack ×0.976, defense ×1.008 (8 games); Knicks attack ×0.997, defense ×0.980 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 14.7 points), no bet.
